Tiny generated fixtures for archive data-service invariants. No copyrighted media.

`store4.rar` and `store5.rar`: run `go run internal/plugins/testdata/archives/generate.go`
from the repository root. Headers are generated by Ether's archivetest builder.

`lzma.7z` and `lzma2.7z`: create `a.txt` containing 30 repetitions of
`first member: abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz` and `b.txt` containing 30 repetitions
of `second member: 0123456789`, with no newlines. Run:

    7zz a -m0=LZMA -md=64k -ms=on lzma.7z a.txt b.txt
    7zz a -m0=LZMA2 -md=64k -ms=on lzma2.7z a.txt b.txt

Both members share a solid compression block; 7-Zip encodes the metadata header.
Tests use the committed archives and never invoke external tools.
